record.question: According to the Central Pollution Control Board, what is the noise limit for residential areas during the day?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation:
CPCB’s report reproducing the Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000 gives 55 dB(A) Leq as the daytime ambient-noise limit for a residential area; “day” is 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. The same table gives a lower nighttime limit of 45 dB(A). The cited report is from 2016 and documents the rule relevant to this exam item; it is not presented as a review of any later rule changes.

Reference: https://cpcb.nic.in/noise_data/Noise_Report_2016.pdf
